lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from high-density, small-diameter clusters near the head to lower-density, larger-diameter nodes along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a series of anchor nodes that define the grid pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.
